text:
Ari: Whos up for a low-key Saturday? Im thinking neighborhood walk, then attempting to make a scrapbook from old concert tickets. open to people + snacks.
Ben: Im down for the walk (need to stretch legs) but scrapbook sounds like serious crafts energy. can bring glue sticks and scissors.
Tess: Scrapbook? count me in. I have a tiny paper trimmer and extra washi tape. also i can bake lemon bars if that helps morale. :lemon:
Rina: Love the lemon bars idea. Id prefer a midday meet, not too early. 11am-ish?
Ari: 11am at the corner by Maple & 5th? walk loop ~40 mins then head back to my place. BYO mementos.
Ben: Works for me. Also if anyone wants to swap plants after were done i have a baby spider plant to trade.
Tess: Trade accepted. also quick poll: bake now or bring later?
Rina: bring later (less chaos during glueing).
Ben: bring later > bake now.
Ari: bring later. saves the table from crumbs :sweat_smile:
CalendarBot: Event created "Maple Walk + Scrapbook" Sat 2026-06-12 11:00 PST  attendees: Ari, Ben, Tess, Rina  https://calendar.example/evt/24680
Tess: Great! Ill also pack extra envelopes and a corner rounder.
Rina: Ill bring bottled water and some napkins.
Ben: Ill bring a bluetooth speaker for mellow tunes. playlist link: https://example.com/playlist/indie-chill
Ari: Perfect. If its hot we can move to the cafe across the street. see you all saturday :)
Tess: Excited  see you! :sparkles:
Rina: Thanks for organizing Ari. :heart:
